question: Can world planning and message delivery scale with nearby observers and target location work instead of global Cartesian scans?
hypothesis: Exact nearest-observer search and target-indexed mailboxes preserve decisions and message order while lowering bounded CPU fixture time.

conditions.method: eight alternating before/after runs in one Node 24 process, median of each

evidence: test/world-runtime-scale.test.mjs checks exact distances after observer motion and deterministic target drains
local TypeScript typecheck, build and focused physics/world tests passed
decision: Keep the exact query and target bucket structure; full CI remains the integration gate
